result:
Enrollments now have an "Observação para o histórico" field. When it is filled in, the transcript and the grades report (boletim) show an observation block with that text. When it is empty, nothing is added. I haven't run the migration, the app or any tests, so none of it has been exercised.

- **Field:** a new `obs_for_transcript` text column on enrollments, added by a migration (`db/migrate/20240910000000_add_obs_for_transcript_to_enrollments.rb`), with `db/schema.rb` updated to match. The migration still needs to be run. I picked the column name myself, since the issue doesn't specify one.
- **Form and label:** it appears in the enrollment create, update and show screens, right after the existing `obs`. The pt-BR label is "Observação para o histórico".
- **PDFs:** a new `enrollment_obs_for_transcript` helper in `app/helpers/enrollments_pdf_helper.rb` draws a bold label with the text below it. Both PDF views call it after the enrollment holds table.
- **Layout:** I didn't have the screenshot from the issue, so the layout is a plain label and paragraph. It may not match the blue-text example.

I didn't add an English locale entry because there is no `enrollment.en.yml` in the repo.
